senses.gloss: f. (עָקַד) tying the sacrifice before slaughtering.
units: Tam. IV, 1 וכך היתה עֲקֵידָתוֹ and in this wise it was tied (and laid down); a. e.—Esp. עֲקֵידַת יצחק, or ע׳ the attempted offering up of Isaac.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 16a:16">R. Hash. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>תקעו … ע׳ יצחק וכ׳</he> blow before me on a ram’s horn, that I may remember to you the offering of Isaac …, and I account it to you, as if you had offered yourselves before me.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:4:2">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ</cite> top <he>יי׳ יראה את נזכר להם עקידתו של וכ׳</he> ‘the Lord shall see’ (<cite ref="Genesis 22:14">Gen. XXII, 14</cite>), thou wilt remember to them the offering of Isaac, their ancestor, &c.; Pesik. Baḥod., p. 154ᵇ <he>עקדת יצחק</he>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56:10">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> <he>תהא נזכר להם אותה העקדה</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 101:7">Yalk. ib. 101</cite> <he>העבודה הזאת</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.
